funFacts: PGA Tour FedExCup Fall heads to Yokohama Country Club in Japan.
Austin Smotherman vaulted from 79th to 51st following Utah victory (-26, 258).
Field competes for 500 FedExCup Fall points and Signature Event exemptions.

headline: Baycurrent Classic: PGA Tour visits Yokohama as FedExCup Fall heats up
whyCareReason: First tee at Yokohama Country Club on 8 October. CBS and GOLF.com list groups. No round score is posted.
teaser: Par 71, 7,322 yards, 8 million dollars. Spieth, Schauffele, Morikawa and Matsuyama have groups. No leader.
story: The Baycurrent Classic is 8 to 11 October at Yokohama Country Club. A Japanese board at 05:00 local time on 8 October still showed pairings, before an 08:45 start. GOLF.com lists Spieth with Min Woo Lee and Sungjae Im, Schauffele with Morikawa and Bridgeman, and Matsuyama with Bradley and Fowler. This card does not name a leader.
